paper.title_en: Ultralight scalar field domain walls and Galileo GNSS atomic clocks
paper.abstract_en: In this article, we study the impact of an Earth-sized ultralight scalar field domain wall (DW) on the European Galileo Global Navigation Satellite System constellation and the feasibility of a related detection. In particular, a set of statistical procedures is developed and implemented to characterize the statistical properties of the background noise for a subnetwork of $N$ Galileo satellite clocks, including a false-alarm rate estimation and a detection efficiency analysis. These methods allow to implement a coincidence analysis and establish a preliminary statistical framework for a robust and controlled search for domain-wall crossings in clock data, and for deriving constraints on the associated fundamental particle physics parameters. The activity is addressed from the point of view of the scientific objectives of the Galileo for Science (G4S$\_2.0$) project.
